RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.title: Missing Pre-Authorization Reference
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.regulatory_source: IRDAI Cashless Claim Guidelines & Master Circular
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.description: Planned surgical or active inpatient procedures require an approved pre-authorization number from the insurer or TPA prior to settlement.
RULE_01_PREAUTH_REQ.suggested_fix: Attach the initial TPA pre-authorization approval letter or input the approved pre-auth reference ID in Section D of Claim Form Part B.

RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.title: Inverted Date Sequence
RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.description: Discharge date is recorded prior to admission date, or bill submission date occurs before hospital discharge.
RULE_02_DATE_CHRONOLOGY.suggested_fix: Verify inpatient admission and discharge timestamps on the clinical indoor case sheet and correct Section B of Claim Form Part B.

RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.title: Diagnosis-Procedure Clinical Incompatibility
RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.description: The billed surgical or medical procedure code (ICD-10-PCS) does not medically align with the primary admitted diagnosis (ICD-10-CM).
RULE_03_DIAG_PROC_MATCH.suggested_fix: Review medical notes to ensure the primary diagnosis justifies the intervention, or include relevant secondary comorbidity codes.

RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.title: Non-Daycare Sub-24hr Admission
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.regulatory_source: IRDAI Health Regulations (Active Hospitalization Minimum Stay Clause)
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.description: Hospital stay duration is under 24 hours for an inpatient claim not classified under the insurer's approved day-care procedure list.
RULE_04_MIN_24HR_STAY.suggested_fix: Check the day-care procedure indicator in Part B Section B(j) or provide a treating physician emergency admission justification certificate.

RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.title: Patient Demographic Mismatch
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: ABDM FHIR Patient Verification & KYC Norms
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.description: Discrepancy detected between patient name spellings across Claim Form Part A, Claim Form Part B, and Discharge Summary.
RULE_05_NAME_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Align patient name spelling on the claim form to match the government ID proof and hospital admission register exactly.

RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.title: Gender-Diagnosis Incompatibility
RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.description: The documented primary ICD-10 code is anatomically restricted to a gender different from the patient's recorded demographic profile.
RULE_06_GENDER_CLINIC_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Verify patient demographic records and re-check ICD-10 coding (e.g., obstetric codes restricted to female patients).

RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.title: Missing Doctor Medical Council Registration
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B (Section A - Facility Details)
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.description: The treating doctor's profile is missing their State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC) registration number.
RULE_07_DOCTOR_REG_MISSING.suggested_fix: Enter the treating doctor's official registration number along with the state medical council name in Part B Section A(f).

RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.title: Missing Hospital Identifier
RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.description: Missing unique ROHINI facility code or TPA network hospital identification code.
RULE_08_HOSPITAL_ID_MISSING.suggested_fix: Provide the 13-digit ROHINI ID allotted by IIB in Part B Section A to confirm accredited network hospital status.

RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.title: Doctor Specialty-Procedure Mismatch
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.regulatory_source: National Medical Commission (NMC) Clinical Governance Norms
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.description: The treating doctor's recorded medical qualification/specialty does not correspond with the specialty required for the billed surgical procedure.
RULE_09_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Include operating surgeon details and credentials alongside the primary treating consultant on the surgical sheet.

RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.title: Duplicate Bill Entries
RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.description: Identical itemized bill charge (such as consultant visit, bed charge, or specific diagnostic test) billed multiple times for the same calendar date.
RULE_10_DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM.suggested_fix: Review the detailed final bill breakdown and remove redundant line-item entries.

RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.title: Lump-Sum Room Rent Billing
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standardized Billing Guidelines (Room Rent Sub-Limits)
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.description: Room rent, nursing fees, and RMO charges are consolidated into a single lump sum rather than itemized per calendar day.
RULE_11_UNITEMIZED_ROOM_RENT.suggested_fix: Break down daily bed charges into room category rent, daily nursing charges, and RMO supervision fees.

RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.title: Missing Implant/Stent Sticker & Invoice
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B (Mandatory Checklist Section)
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.description: High-value implants, stents, or mesh are billed without accompanying manufacturer invoices, batch numbers, or sticker tags.
RULE_12_IMPLANT_INVOICE_MISSING.suggested_fix: Attach manufacturer tax invoice copies and scan original implant outer-pouch stickers with batch and serial numbers.

RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.title: Expenses Incurred Outside Stay Window
RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.description: Investigation or pharmacy bill dates fall outside the documented admission and discharge date interval without pre/post-hospitalization classification.
RULE_13_DATE_DISCREPANCY_BILL.suggested_fix: Move out-of-window expenses to pre/post-hospitalization categories (Claim Form Part A) or correct billing ledger dates.

RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.title: Late Submission Window
RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.description: Claim submission date approaches or exceeds the regulatory submission window (standard 15 days for cashless dossier dispatch).
RULE_14_FILING_DEADLINE_RISK.suggested_fix: Dispatch claim dossier immediately and attach an administrative delay explanation letter if filing after cutoff.

RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.title: Incomplete Document Checklist
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.regulatory_source: IRDAI Claim Form Part B Enclosure Checklist
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.description: Mandatory checklist enclosures in Part B (such as indoor case papers, detailed discharge summary, or doctor prescriptions) are marked missing.
RULE_15_MISSING_MANDATORY_DOCS.suggested_fix: Verify that all items checked in the Part B document checklist are physically scanned and annexed to the dossier.

RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.title: Bill Total Discrepancy
RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.description: The calculated mathematical sum of individual itemized charges does not equal the gross claimed total amount in Part A/B.
RULE_16_ARITHMETIC_TOTAL_MISMATCH.suggested_fix: Recompute the final hospital bill total and align line items with discount, tax, and net payable fields.

RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.title: Diagnostic-Only Admission Risk
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.regulatory_source: IRDAI Standard Policy Exclusions (Clause: Diagnostic Hospitalization)
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.description: Inpatient record reflects diagnostic evaluations and investigations without active pharmacological or surgical treatment administered.
RULE_17_INVESTIGATION_ONLY_FLAG.suggested_fix: Ensure discharge summary details active medical treatment, IV medication administration, and physician progress notes justifying admission.

RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.title: Missing Insured Banking Info
RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.description: Bank account number, IFSC code, or bank branch details are absent from Claim Form Part A Section F.
RULE_18_BANK_DETAILS_MISSING.suggested_fix: Complete Section F of Part A with bank account details and attach a cancelled cheque copy bearing the policyholder's name.
